evidence.title: Pricing | Elicit: The AI Research Assistant

name: Elicit
summary: AI research assistant that searches 138M+ academic papers and drafts cited reports, tables and reviews.
description: Elicit searches 138 million academic papers and 545,000 clinical trials, then drafts fully cited research reports, comparison tables and systematic review screening. The free Basic plan has unlimited search; paid plans from $11/month add the Research Agent, exports, API access and collaboration. Used by researchers, clinicians, students and pharma teams.
